Type: distressed medallion area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area, covering a floor; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: bohemian, traditional, glam
Materials: low-pile woven fibers with a faded vintage finish
Colors: hot pink, coral orange, navy, cream
Shape: rectangle, central floral medallion with all-over ornate motifs, distressed faded areas, border band, low pile, bold visual weight
Feel: vibrant, playful, warm, eclectic
Goes with: dark wood floors, grey upholstery, woven baskets; bohemian or eclectic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Vibrant Medallion Rug, 5' x 8', Pink
product.description: Pile: 100% Polypropylene, Backing: 100% Jute Imported The vibrant colors and medallion design of this rug are sure to add an exciting pop of style to any room. Its beautiful hues of deep rouge outlined in blue make it the perfect addition to neutral décor. Distressed floral design Bright pattern with blue border Low, 0.2" pile suits high-traffic, transitional indoor areas Pair with a rug pad (sold separately) 5' x 8' Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow a few days for fibers to settle
